description: For every actual term \(t\) and assignment \(u\), evaluation in the specified quotient satisfies \(t^{Q_N}[q\circ u]=q((t^E)^N[u])\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.term_projection.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {N : Type z} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N]
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Axioms L N) (t : L.Term α) (a : α → N) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.projection h ∘ a) t =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.projection h
      (FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize a (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.termTranslate t))
